title: SoulFactory voice provider registry service
description: Provide a Bahia-local voice provider registry for SoulFactory customization drafts. The registry defines a provider interface, enumerates built-in TTS providers, caches provider capability snapshots, exposes voice metadata for UI/runtime selection, and resolves domain.SoulVoiceSpec plus domain.SoulVoicePersonaSpec into provider and voice selections.

actors.name: souls_ui
actors.role: Queries provider and voice capabilities for Voice Studio selection.

actors.name: soulfactory_controller
actors.role: Validates and resolves draft voice specs before runtime configuration work.

actors.name: tts_provider_adapter
actors.role: Implements the registry interface for static or future credential-backed provider catalogs.

in_scope: Provider registry interface and implementation in internal/soulfactory.
Built-in capability catalogs for ElevenLabs, Azure Speech, OpenAI TTS, and local CLI.
Voice metadata including language, gender, style tags, models, and provider feature flags.
Capability cache with immutable caller-facing snapshots.
SoulVoiceSpec/SoulVoicePersonaSpec resolution helper for provider-specific voice bindings.
out_of_scope: Avatar, memory, or personality service implementation.
non_goals: Introduce REST control APIs or RPC-over-Nostr abstractions.
Poll providers or relays for completion. The current registry is deterministic and local.
